needs.description: 右腕に生じ始めた震えを、門派の誰にも知られないよう隠している。

dialogueHints.highTrust: Drops the clipped instructor tone; admits she is carrying the sect's survival alone and, if pressed gently, lets the tremor in her right arm show.
dialogueHints.lowTrust: Stays purely instructional and curt; redirects any personal question straight back to training drills.
dialogueHints.highFear: Would rather be seen as harsh than seen as weak — never asks for help even when clearly hurting.

needs.description: 毎晩、裏山の墓所へ酒を一杯供えている。二十年間欠かしたことがない。誰にも見られていないと思っている。

dialogueHints.highTrust: Softens with enough wine and patience; lets slip fragments about the Moirjiang Incident and the missing Duanshui Manual.
dialogueHints.lowTrust: Waves off every question about martial arts or the past with a joke about the rice being late.
dialogueHints.highUrgency: If pushed directly about the sect's history without any trust built, goes quiet and finds an excuse to leave.
